text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(This is completely different from a 
medium-distance race—such raw heat...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Faster, faster, even a little further 
ahead—! ...Ngh, but, out of breath—! 
...Guh!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I don't... care about any of that! Right 
now, I'm putting everything I have into 
this—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Curren Bouquetd'or!! Here 
comes Curren Bouquetd'or!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or crosses the finish line 
in first!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tiara Umamusume, Curren Bouquetd'or!! She 
has left behind a new brilliance on the 
turf...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘She really won...!’ ‘Bouquet is 
incredible!!’ ‘A victory seized together 
with her Trainer!’ ‘The absolute best!’ 
‘*sniff*! Good for them, both of 
them...!’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Such thunderous cheering—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Amidst the wild fervor, she stood 
motionless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tremble runs deep within my chest. 
History, which had stood still for 
decades, was set in motion by her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't find the right words. Even so—I 
have to convey them properly to her right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aah! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Wah, I— dedicate this—to you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It is a very special flower! A spring 
chrysanthemum, just for you—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus—this unprecedented result began 
weaving an unforeseen future.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Um... could you be Curren Bouquetd'or?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I watched your performance in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)! I could hardly believe it—it 
was so incredibly moving!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"If you ask me, that Tenno Sho (Spring) 
result was definitely the synergy between 
you and Trainer <username>!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>? Are you Curren Bouquetd'or's 
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Social Media User A
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I recognized that name from 
somewhere—it's from the winner's interview 
at the Fukushima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Social Media User B
text_block_list.text:
"'It was all thanks to Trainer <username> that I was 
able to win!' Man, this is amazing."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, right? You've been getting quite 
a bit of buzz since the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the old days, she's been 
brilliant yet reserved. Always going out 
of her way to help others.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Having the spotlight shine on him like 
this— It brings me great joy as well.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Having the spotlight on someone like her 
like this— is something that brings me 
great joy as well.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"You've been amazing lately! I hear your 
name everywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Right? It really feels like all your past 
achievements are finally getting the 
spotlight, Senpai...! Man, it's so 
inspiring!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliance at the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
shone down upon me as I stood beside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, my reputation grew, and 
I even began receiving invitations to 
research symposiums hosted by the top 
tier.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you, Bouquet, really

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on a day like that, when 
things were changing at a dizzying pace—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone. Today's guests 
are—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Here is Curren Bouquetd'or, who achieved a 
remarkable performance in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), along with Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Our journey so far, all of it—it really is 
entirely thanks to your hard work, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
They're someone who always puts Umamusume 
first, and with all their accumulated 
knowledge— they've continually supported 
us with a steady, reliable hand.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I never could have made the decision to 
take on the Tenno Sho (Spring) without 
you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So you place an immense amount 
of trust in them!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, now that you've heard Bouquet's 
passionate feelings, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, I recall the anxiety I once 
harbored.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because the one at the center of 
that dream is a nobody like me...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because the one at the center of 
that dream is a nobody like me...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it was meant to be dedicated to a more 
prominent, first-rate veteran Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then, I used to think that way 
sometimes too. However, now—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tiara Umamusume, Curren Bouquetd'or!! She 
has left behind a new brilliance on the 
turf...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or led me to a single 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Going forward, I strongly feel that I 
want to continue supporting her from the 
closest vantage point."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, those words had slipped 
from my lips.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I'm... so sorry—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*, ...hic! I-It won't... stop—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The scene wrapped up with tears of joy. 
...However, even after the shoot ended, 
her tears didn't stop for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*. ......— I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm just so happy that you'll 
continue to be by my side...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I am an Umamusume, after all. I can 
only imagine the hardships of being a 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Just from seeing your state and the 
situation... it's just a feeling I 
had...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just kept thinking... that eventually, 
you might decide to step down as my 
trainer...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what, no matter what... I just 
didn't want you to leave without gaining 
anything—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If we part without me handing you the 
golden bouquet, you'll have to start over 
from scratch again...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So at the very least, before I depart, a 
special single flower... please."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to present you with a flower 
that will guide you to what comes next—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—It felt as though all the dots suddenly 
connected.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Why did she suddenly declare her 
challenge for the Tenno Sho (Spring)?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me run in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she plead with such overwhelming 
fervor, and pour her heart and soul into 
racing through each day—?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before our break... would it be all right 
if I swam just a little bit more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My voice trembles. I can't seem to find 
the right words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm not worthy of her. Maybe I'm not 
capable of supporting her all the way to 
the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Constantly clutching her head out of 
self-preservation... she realized it all 
on her own, and made her decision before 
anyone even noticed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to aim to become a truly special 
flower—for the sake of the future me who 
cast her aside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In order to forge my own path as an 
accomplished trainer whose Tiara route 
Umamusume produced results in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just so glad... that the spotlight 
has finally started to shine on you after 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even after that—you told me— that you 
wouldn't leave—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: So—I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I-I'm sorry... Please don't worry 
about me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now I finally realize it. The truth is, 
all along—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And gathering more victories than my two 
hands can hold.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I want to deliver a golden-glowing 
bouquet to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought what she said that day was 
simply born out of her gentle nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, that wasn't it―― That wasn't all 
there was to it.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To her, I was "special."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it meant challenging a dizzyingly 
high wall— I wanted so badly to make the 
future shine.
choice_data_list:
I'm not going anywhere. I'll stay right by 
your side.
I won't ever leave your side

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
Let's keep gathering victories together, 
forever and always.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Together, forever...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Are you really, truly sure...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —It's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, I spent the entire evening 
reviewing her upcoming racing schedule.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen here. The presence of one's 
Trainer is far greater than we might 
think."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Do not lose sight of that responsibility 
and honor, and hold them firmly in your 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Only now do I truly understand the 
meaning of what the Chief Trainer told me 
that day."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I had stood beside her and walked 
together with her, I surely would have 
come to understand on my own the true 
weight of the 'Golden Bouquet.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I thought it was enough just to 
fulfill my role as a 'Trainer,' but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I want to present her with a 
brilliance equal to the 'Golden Bouquet' 
she holds."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Curren Bouquetd'or is a truly 
wonderful Umamusume who opened up new 
possibilities for Tiara Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to show this world, with utmost 
conviction, that she is an Umamusume whose 
brilliance will shine on into the distant 
future, carving her name into racing 
history.
choice_data_list:
(A Trainer is someone who walks the path 
right beside you.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... as our next target 
race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand 
Prix where the competitors are decided by 
fan vote. In other words, it is a race 
where you shoulder the fans' expectations 
more than ever."
choice_data_list:
I want to make your existence known to 
this world, loud and clear

I want to powerfully demonstrate your 
existence to the world.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
I want to offer a brilliance that rivals a 
bouquet of gold.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That... could never be.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...My heart feels so warm. Fufu, is this 
how you felt too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm glad they got to learn about it.

Yeah, I'm glad you were able to learn 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I spent all of last night thinking about 
what it would take to make her name known 
to the world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, I suddenly remembered how the fans 
looked during the Fan Appreciation 
Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for Curren Bouquetd'or's success 
with all their heart, they pulled off a 
heartfelt surprise. And that truly became 
a source of strength for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that their cheers might be 
the very power that propels her into 
becoming a 'legendary Umamusume'?"
choice_data_list:
I want to run a race that lives up to the 
fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Live up to the fans' expectations, and 
bloom even stronger. Then their 
expectations grow further――and surely, 
that cycle will make her shine brighter 
and brighter.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘She really won...!’ ‘Bouquet is 
incredible!!’ ‘A victory seized together 
with her Trainer!’ ‘The absolute best!’ 
‘*sniff*! Good for them, both of 
them...!’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I received so many heartwarming cheers at 
the Tenno Sho (Spring) as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Those cheers filled with anticipation will 
surely continue to give me so much 
strength from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And if that, in due course— leads to the 
bouquet of gold, then by all means, I wish 
to face it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you bestow brilliance upon me, then I, 
too, wish without fail to gather a bouquet 
of gold for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heading toward overlapping futures, first 
up is the Grand Prix race, the Takarazuka 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to run through it all, side by side 
with you—!
